mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_status_logs ( id, space_id, event_id, participant_id, application_id, action, reason, block_reapply, actor_kind, actor_user_id, created_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{participantId}, #{applicationId}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{blockReapply}, #{actorKind}, #{actorUserId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.submitted_at, a.status FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = p.space_id AND a.event_id = p.event_id AND a.participant_id = p.id ORDER BY a.revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT l.created_at, l.reason, l.block_reapply, u.display_name FROM application_status_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.actor_user_id WHERE l.space_id = p.space_id AND l.event_id = p.event_id AND l.participant_id = p.id AND l.action = 'WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY l.seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT latest.id AS application_id, p.id AS participant_id, p.name, latest.submitted_at, w.created_at AS withdrawn_at, w.display_name AS withdrawn_by_display_name, w.reason, coalesce(w.block_reapply, false) AS reapply_blocked, g.id AS previous_group_id, g.name AS previous_group_name, c.checked_in_at FROM participants p JOIN LATERAL () latest ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL () w ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT gl.from_group_id FROM group_assignment_logs gl WHERE gl.space_id = p.space_id AND gl.event_id = p.event_id AND gl.participant_id = p.id AND gl.cause = 'WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY gl.seq DESC LIMIT 1) wl ON true LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.space_id = p.space_id AND g.event_id = p.event_id AND g.id = wl.from_group_id LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.space_id = p.space_id AND c.event_id = p.event_id AND c.participant_id = p.id AND c.status = 'CHECKED_IN'
mapper.select: WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND latest.status = 'WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.id
WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND latest.status = 'WITHDRAWN' AND latest.id = #{applicationId}
